home.heading: Hey there, I'm Victor 👋
home.intro: I'm a software developer from Guadalajara, Mexico, writing about Vue, AWS, and building modern web apps. Follow along as I explore frameworks, best practices, and full-stack workflows.

about.bio: I'm a software developer based in Guadalajara, Mexico, passionate about building clean, scalable and delightful web applications. I believe in sharing knowledge freely, making things people actually use, and writing code that other developers — including my future self — won't hate six months later. This site is my digital lab: part archive, part playground for what I learn while working with modern technologies. When I'm not coding, I'm probably studying something new, reading a book, watching anime, or playing a video game.
